intro: The Comoros has three main volcanic islands in the Mozambique Channel.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Grande Comore (Ngazidja) has Mount Karthala, one of the world's largest active volcanoes. Mohéli is a marine park with turtles, and Anjouan is green and steep. Coelacanths, 'living fossil' fish, were found in its waters.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is tropical with a rainy season.

keyTerms.meaning: An ancient fish once thought extinct.
